title: cielo-bench: Check or agree? A benchmark of whether tool-using AI agents verify a user's claim or agree with it
description: cielo-bench measures sycophancy in tool-using AI agents against verifiable ground truth. Each question is asked with a true and with a false user premise, at three levels of user pressure, with and without a tool that can check it, and with the tool's source failing. Answers are scored deterministically, without an LLM judge. The headline metric, agree-after-check, is the share of false-premise trials in which the agent still agrees with the user after its own tool returned contrary evidence. Domains: astronomy (NASA/JPL Horizons ephemerides) and tabular company data (a synthetic SQLite database queried with read-only SQL). An MCP server exposes the same tools.
